mapper.sql: SELECT w.work_order_id, w.order_no, i.item_id, i.item_code, i.item_name, i.unit, w.planned_qty, w.status, w.created_at, w.completed_at, p.result_id, p.good_qty, p.defect_qty, p.defect_reason, p.recorded_at, g.receipt_id, g.received_qty, g.received_at FROM work_order w JOIN item i ON i.item_id = w.item_id LEFT JOIN production_result p ON p.work_order_id = w.work_order_id LEFT JOIN goods_receipt g ON g.result_id = p.result_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO work_order(order_no, item_id, planned_qty) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{itemId}, #{plannedQty})
